environment.description: Container running Ubuntu 22.04 base image with default Docker configuration. The CLI tool is compiled with gcc -O2 (no ASAN, no stack protector flags beyond default). Container runs as root with read-write filesystem. /tmp is a standard writable tmpfs. The tool reads untrusted input from a network socket piped to stdin via socat. No seccomp profile applied beyond Docker default. ASLR is enabled but heap layout is deterministic enough for exploitation due to sequential allocation pattern.
